dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Honeybun is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Honeybun has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to be tense while in kennel and will escalate to thrashing while on leash. In one instance while exiting the kennel room, Honeybun redirected onto the handler biting them twice on the leg. This did not break skin. With handlers Honeybun is receptive to a slow approach, coaxing, toys, and treats. Medically, Honeybun has mild-moderate dental disease, lameness in the left front, a wound, and is in heat.

Honeybun arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, she has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to be tense while in kennel and will escalate to thrashing while on leash. In one instance while exiting the kennel room, Honeybun redirected onto the handler biting them twice on the leg. This bite did not break skin. Due to the detailed behavior we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Honeybun
